corrections.what: Withdrew the phone number (660) 359-5621, which we had published as Wright Memorial Hospital's main line. Newer sources attribute that number to the Custer Clinic, not to the hospital, and sources now disagree on the hospital's main line — so we publish none. If you saved that number from this site for the hospital, do not use it. This was our error, found in our own re-check rather than reported by a reader, and in an emergency the number is 911 either way.
